title.zh: VAST开源实时世界模型EdenLive！单消费级显卡、720P超24FPS
title.en: VAST开源实时世界模型EdenLive！单消费级显卡、720P超24FPS

current_state.zh:
VAST 开源了实时交互世界模型 EdenLive，官方称其可在单张消费级显卡上以 720P 分辨率、超过 24FPS 的帧率运行。该发布以“让人人都能自由创造并体验可交互世界”为定位。

在单张消费级显卡上以 720P、超过 24FPS 运行交互式世界模型，降低了开发者和创作者本地运行此类模型的硬件门槛，不再必须依赖服务器集群。

720P 与 24FPS 以上的数据来自 VAST 自身的发布口径，此次发布未包含第三方独立基准测试结果。该模型以开源形式发布。
current_state.en: VAST has open-sourced EdenLive, a real-time interactive world model that runs 720P at over 24 FPS on a single consumer-grade GPU.

updates.detailed_summary_en: VAST has open-sourced EdenLive, a real-time interactive world model that runs 720P at over 24 FPS on a single consumer-grade GPU.
updates.background_zh: 交互式世界模型需要根据用户控制实时生成画面，同时尽量保持长时程一致性，这与一次性视频生成是不同的问题。该方向近期的公开工作包括微软基于《我的世界》构建的交互式世界模型 MineWorld，以及聚焦实时响应与长时程一致性的 WorldPlay2 论文。VAST 以 VAST-AI 名义在 Hugging Face 上发布模型。
updates.background_en: Interactive world models generate frames in response to user controls in real time while trying to keep long-horizon consistency, a distinct problem from one-off video generation. Recent public work in this area includes Microsoft's MineWorld, an interactive world model built on Minecraft, and the WorldPlay2 paper, which targets real-time responsiveness alongside long-horizon consistency. VAST publishes models under the VAST-AI organization on Hugging Face.
updates.market_impact_zh: 对加密市场的传导路径是间接的：可在单张消费级显卡上运行的实时世界模型，与聚合消费级硬件的去中心化算力网络相关，也会影响更广泛的 AI 算力叙事情绪。VAST 此次发布本身不涉及代币或链上组件。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path to crypto markets is indirect: a real-time world model that fits on a single consumer-grade GPU is relevant to decentralized compute networks that aggregate consumer hardware, and to AI-compute sentiment more broadly. VAST's release itself carries no token or on-chain component.
